{{Quote|The last time-when Vader's men were here. They had that... thing with them.”<br>”You mean the Inquisitor.|Tlinetha and Tyno Fabris|<ref name="Last Jedi" />}}
After capturing [[Thi Xon Yimmon]] [[501st Legion/Legends|Vader's Fist]] briefly visited [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]] and [[Concordia/Legends|Concordia]]. The [[Balosar/Legends|Balosar]] [[Waiter/Legends|waitress]] [[Tlinetha]] picked up that the air around an '''Inquisitor''' who part of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] convoy shivered as if it was charged, a feeling she had only felt once before in a [[Unidentified Jedi (Tlinetha)|Jedi]]. Little did the server know it was the [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitor's]] [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-[[Force-sensitive/Legends|sensitivity]]. She later told [[Tyno Fabris]] that the sensation that [[Jax Pavan]] released was the same as the Inquisitor and [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi]]. <ref name="Last Jedi" />
